page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: CALENDARIUM with Hebrew line and "Mensis Secundus." Below it a calendar table: left column year and months with dates, a column of day numbers "Dies.", a column headed "2. MAR CHESVAN dierum 29." with feast notes, and a right-hand column of text. Faint bleed-through from the reverse page is ignored. Catchword/signature at foot: "Mensis" at right foot.

main_text.head: CALENDARIUM Mensis Secundus.
main_text.p: 2. MAR CHESVAN dierum 29. Octavus in anno sacro. Ejus Character hoc anno 4. 14. 417. Hic Mensis בשנה טליפה in anno Abundanti augetur uno die. Sunt in eo anno tres Mensis continuè pleni, primus, secundus, & tertius.
Die 7. excæcatur Sedekias & filii ejus coram eo jugulantur. Jeremiæ 52. Quæ causa est jejunij.

page.notes: Hebrew phrase in the right column is printed Hebrew, transcribed as best read. Faint show-through from the facing page (calendar text of the other side) omitted. The table cells on the far right and left are partly illegible; lines are given as read. Left running head reads CALENDARIUM with the number 10 at top left.
